summary: The registrant, Civista Bancshares, Inc., filed an 8-K solely to announce the release date of its second quarter 2026 financial results — a routine earnings calendar notice. The press release attached as Exhibit 99.1 details the date, time, and access information for the earnings call and webcast. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change is mentioned. The filing is a standard current report on Form 8-K under Item 8.01 (Other Events) with no material transaction or corporate action other than the scheduling of a regular quarterly earnings release.
